description: Defines the Payload interface for the Ditto Protocol Adapter, including methods for building and accessing payload properties such as path, value, extra data, status, revision, timestamp, metadata, and fields.

classes.name: Payload
classes.description: Interface representing the payload of an adaptable entity, with methods to access payload properties and static builder methods.

classes.name: JsonFields
classes.description: Contains definitions of JSON fields used in Payload serialization, such as path, value, extra, status, revision, timestamp, metadata, and fields.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new PayloadBuilder for a specified path.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new PayloadBuilder without a path.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new PayloadBuilder initialized with the properties of an existing Payload.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the path associated with this payload.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the payload's value.

methods.name: getExtra
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing extra enrichment data.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the payload's status code.

methods.name: getRevision
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the revision number.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the timestamp.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing field selectors.
